title: Pulsar Pro Beyond Friday: double cashback at Lidl, Aldi, dm, Rossmann, Bolt and Glovo until 30 November
summary: Pulsar Pro members earn double cashback in Pulsar Points at a new group of brands each week of November. The last week, 23 to 30 November 2026, covers everyday essentials: Lidl, Aldi, dm, Rossmann, Bolt and Glovo.
body:
How it works, in Pulsar's own terms:
- Only for Pulsar Pro subscribers; Pro costs $99.99 a year or $9.99 a month, and Free users keep their normal rate
- Pay with your Pulsar card at a participating brand during its campaign week
- Eligible purchases earn double your normal cashback rate in Pulsar Points: on a 2% rate, 4%
- Up to two eligible purchases per brand; the normal monthly cashback limits still apply
- Refunded purchases lose their points

Earlier weeks covered online shopping (Amazon, eBay, SHEIN, Temu), fashion and sportswear, and tech and gaming. The campaign ends at 00:00 UTC on 1 December 2026.

title: ether.fi Black Friday Boost: 20% cashback on your first $250, up to $50
summary: Join ether.fi through G2M's link by 30 November 2026 and get 20% cashback on your first $250 of card purchases made from 23 to 30 November, so up to $50 back.
body:
How it works, in ether.fi's own terms:
- Sign up through G2M's link by 30 November 2026, 23:59 UTC; only new personal accounts that join through a participating creator's link qualify
- Verify your identity and get your ether.fi card
- Spend with the card from 23 to 30 November 2026; purchases before 23 November don't count
- 20% is the total rate on your first $250 of card purchases, including your normal cashback, so up to $50 per person
- Nothing to claim: the cashback reaches your ether.fi account within 30 days after 30 November
- Refunded or declined purchases, cash equivalents, business accounts and more than one account per person don't count

The offer runs while ether.fi's promotion budget lasts and isn't available in every country. After it, the free Core tier pays 3% cashback.

title: KAST: 5% back on your first bank transfer for new users, and 10% on PlayStation games
summary: New KAST users who join through G2M's link by 9 December 2026 get 5% back on their first incoming bank transfer of $50 or more, up to $15. Until 25 November, a first PlayStation Store game purchase of $70 or more gets 10% back, up to $10.
body:
The bank transfer reward, in KAST's own terms:
- For new users who sign up between 18 November and 9 December 2026
- 5% of your first qualifying incoming bank transfer of at least $50, credited to your KAST account by 9 December
- Up to $15 by SEPA (EUR), Faster Payments (GBP), ACH, FedNow, Fedwire or SWIFT (USD), and up to $10 by Pix (BRL), Bre-B (COP) or a local ARS transfer; MXN transfers have their own offer
- Card and Apple Pay top-ups, crypto deposits and transfers between KAST accounts don't count
- Paid to your KAST Reward Balance within 14 days after 9 December; no claim needed

The PlayStation offer:
- 10% back, up to $10, on your first PlayStation Store game purchase of $70 or more in one payment, settled by 25 November 2026, 23:59 UTC
- For users with less than $100 of lifetime KAST Card spending on 17 November; limited to the first 600 rewards
- Consoles, accessories, gift cards and wallet top-ups don't count; paid by 8 December

Also until 31 December, KAST pays 4% USD cashback with no cap to existing users it picked at random and told by message. You can't apply for it.

title: Nexo Card: 10% back in NEXO on your first PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store purchase
summary: Pay with your Nexo Card at the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store and get 10% back in NEXO tokens on your first purchase there. The offer runs until 31 December 2026.
body:
What Nexo says:
- 10% back in NEXO, credited instantly
- Applies to your first purchase at the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store with the Nexo Card
- Runs until 31 December 2026

Nexo announced the offer on its X account; it has not published a cap or full terms on its website. The Nexo Card's normal cashback is 0.5% to 2% in NEXO, depending on your loyalty tier.

title: Solid's new referral bonus: $10 card credit when you join, $50 more at $5,000
summary: Since 17 November 2026, joining Solid through G2M's link gets you $10 in card credit after you spend $150 at 3 or more shops in your first 30 days, and $50 more after you spend $5,000 in your first 90 days.
body:
How it works, in Solid's own terms:
- Sign up with a referral link; both time limits start that day
- Spend $150 in your first 30 days at 3 or more different shops, at least $10 at each: you get $10 in card credit
- Spend $5,000 in your first 90 days: you get $50 more in card credit
- The person who invited you gets the same two bonuses
- Card credit is spent with your Solid card and used first at checkout; it can't be withdrawn or transferred and doesn't expire
- Purchases under $2, transfers, wallet top-ups, gift cards, game credit, gambling and refunded purchases don't count

This replaces the $25 in FUSE bonus. People who joined before 17 November 2026 stay on the earlier rules.

Solid's card pays 3% cashback in USDC on the free Core tier, up to $50 a month.

title: Kite Card: 10% back on GTA VI, plus 5% offers until 30 November
summary: Buy GTA VI with the Kite Card between 17 and 30 November 2026 and get 10% back, up to $50. Kite's 5% offers on Grab, travel, streaming, AI tools and Starlink also run until 30 November.
body:
The Kite Card is a prepaid US dollar Visa for nine countries: Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines and Australia.

The GTA VI offer:
- 10% back on GTA VI Standard or Ultimate Edition, up to $50 per person in total
- Buy between 17 and 30 November 2026 and pay in full with the Kite Card
- Only at the Rockstar Games Store, PlayStation Store or Xbox Store; add-ons and in-game currency don't count
- Paid once in US dollars to your Kite Card after the refund period, expected by 21 December 2026

Also until 30 November 2026, 5% back with no cap on:
- Grab
- Travel booked on Travala: flights, hotels, car rentals and activities
- Netflix, YouTube Premium, Prime Video and Spotify
- Eligible AI subscriptions such as ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro
- Figma, LinkedIn Premium, X Premium and Telegram Premium
- Your Starlink bill

Cashback stays pending for 30 days before it is paid, and refunded purchases earn nothing.

title: ether.fi Cash card drops the FX fee on Swiss franc purchases
summary: Since 16 November 2026, purchases charged in Swiss francs on the ether.fi Cash card have no FX markup, the same as euros. You pay the market rate.
body:
The rule applies when the merchant charges in Swiss francs (CHF), whichever asset you spend.

- If a terminal offers to convert the amount to another currency, choose to pay in CHF, or a conversion fee may still apply
- Cashback still applies: euro and Swiss franc purchases earn 3% on the first $800 a month on the free Core tier ($3,000 on Luxe, $16,000 on Pinnacle), counted in the same monthly total as your other spending
- US dollar purchases also have no FX fee; other currencies cost 0.5% on Core, 0.25% on Luxe and nothing on Pinnacle and VIP, on top of the card network's exchange rate

Also new: since 30 October 2026, tax and rent payments made with the card earn cashback at your normal rate.

title: XPlace Card: $5 to $250 in crypto when you join with a referral
summary: Join XPlace through G2M's link, activate your card and spend $100 in Credit Mode: you get a random amount between $5 and $250 in Bitcoin, Solana or Ethereum.
body:
How it works, in XPlace's own terms:
- Sign up with a referral link and activate your XPlace card
- Spend $100 or more in Credit Mode, where you borrow against your deposits instead of spending them
- You and the person who invited you each get a random amount between $5 and $250, paid in Bitcoin, Solana or Ethereum, as you choose

Good to know: Cash Mode purchases don't count toward the $100. Credit Mode borrowing carries interest, and your deposits can be liquidated if prices fall. XPlace is not available in India, China, Turkey, Vietnam and 13 other countries, or in 19 US states.

title: COCA Card: 8% cashback on your first 3 purchases if you join in November
summary: Join COCA through an affiliate link, such as G2M's, in November 2026 and get 8% cashback on your first 3 card purchases, on up to $300 in total, so up to $24 back. No staking or paid plan needed.
body:
8% is normally COCA's top tier rate, which needs 30,000 COCA tokens. This welcome offer gives it to new users from their first purchase.

- Sign up through an affiliate link, such as G2M's, between 2 and 30 November 2026 and verify your identity; signing up without one doesn't qualify
- Get the free virtual COCA Card and add money by bank transfer, card transfer or stablecoin deposit
- Make your first 3 eligible purchases by 30 November 2026, 23:59 UTC
- The 8% applies to up to $300 across those 3 purchases; anything above earns your normal tier rate (1% on the free Starter tier)
- Cashback stays pending for 14 days, then you claim it to your USD or EUR balance in the app

The COCA Card is available to residents of 70+ countries. A physical card costs $5 plus delivery.

title: KAST Points end on 30 November; card cashback continues
summary: KAST stops giving KAST Points on 30 November 2026. In the first week of December, eligible points become KAST Pioneer Units, and other users get reward vouchers. USD cashback on the card continues.
body:
What changes:
- Until 30 November 2026, eligible spending still earns KAST Points under the current terms
- In the first week of December, eligible points convert into KAST Pioneer Units (KPUs). KPUs are not shares, can't be sold or traded and have no guaranteed cash value; KAST says it plans periodic cash-out options
- To keep KPUs, you complete a short acknowledgement in the app by a deadline KAST will announce in December
- Users not eligible for KPUs get KAST reward vouchers for eligible spending instead, with details in December
- US users have a separate program

What stays: USD cashback of 1.5% on the free Standard card (on the first $2,000 a month), 2% on Premium (first $10,000) and 3% on Private (first $40,000). Premium and Private lose the extra points they earned on top.

title: Tria Card fees: 0.5% on every purchase, plus 1% outside US dollars
summary: Tria's help center now lists a 0.5% Tria fee on every card purchase on all memberships, plus a 1% Visa fee on purchases in other currencies. Cashback stays at 1.5% to 6%.
body:
The card fees Tria now lists:
- 0.5% Tria fee on every card purchase, on Lite, Pro and Max
- 1% Visa foreign exchange fee on purchases not in US dollars, so 1.5% in total
- No Tria fee to deposit
- On Lite, cashback above the $1,000 monthly cap is now 0.5%; Pro and Max keep 1%
- ATM on Pro and Max: $1 + 1% per withdrawal, up to $750 a withdrawal and 3 tries a day

Membership prices are unchanged: $20 a year for Lite, $109 for Pro and $250 for Max. Cashback is 1.5% on Lite, 4.5% on Pro and 6% on Max, and Tria Travel bookings earn the same rate with no cap. After the 0.5% fee, Lite pays 1% net on US dollar spending up to $1,000 a month.

title: Pulsar Pro: 4% back on your first $3,000 of card spending in November
summary: Pulsar Pro members, new and existing, earn 4% back in Pulsar Points on their first $3,000 of eligible card spending in November 2026. Pro costs $99.99 a year or $9.99 a month.
body:
How it works:
- 4% back in Pulsar Points on the first $3,000 of eligible card spending in November, then 0.5% up to $10,000
- Applies to existing and new Pro subscribers
- Points refund part or all of an eligible purchase in USDC and expire after 60 days on Pro

Pulsar Money is a virtual Visa that spends US dollar or euro balances funded with stablecoins. At 4% on $3,000, November's points are worth up to $120, against a Pro price of $99.99 a year or $9.99 a month.

title: Solid's Rain-issued cards stop working on 20 November
summary: Solid cards issued by Rain, and Rain US bank details, close on 20 November 2026. Where cards are still offered, you can switch to a new Wirex-issued Solid card in the app; elsewhere the card closes but your Solid account keeps working.
body:
If you have a Rain-issued Solid card, the app shows a banner on Home and a notice on your card screen that tells you which case applies.

If you can switch:
- Tap Get new card in the app; switching is not automatic
- Withdraw any money left on the Rain card to your Solid wallet when the app asks
- Verify your identity again, since the new card comes from a different provider
- Activate the new card, then add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay and update your saved cards and subscriptions

The new Wirex-issued card keeps your cashback tier and adds Credit mode, euro spending with no FX fee from a EUR balance and a free euro account with your own IBAN.

If cards are no longer offered in your country, move your card balance to your Solid wallet before 20 November. Your savings, deposits, sends and swaps keep working, and cashback you already earned stays yours. US Virtual Accounts with Rain close too, so stop sharing those bank details.

title: Plasma One: $10 spend credit when you join with a referral code
summary: Join Plasma One through G2M's link or with G2M's referral code and spend $100 at two or more merchants within 14 days: you get $10 in spend credit.
body:
How it works, in Plasma's own terms:
- Join Plasma One with a referral code and finish setting up your account
- Make card purchases of at least $100 in total at two or more different merchants within 14 days
- The $10 spend credit is paid on the Thursday after your qualifying purchases settle
- Spending the whole $100 at one merchant doesn't count, and neither do refunds or transfers
- Not available when the country on your ID is Nigeria, Bangladesh or Kenya

The offer has no set end date. Plasma One's free Standard tier pays 1% cashback in XPL on the first $500 a month.
